Top story: a letter to my love

Joshua, today the whole front page belongs to you. You are God’s special and precious gift to me, and one of the greatest blessings He has ever given me. You are a God-fearing, God-honoring man who loves me so much, supports me in everything, and brings peace wherever you go. I love you more than words can say, and I thank God for you every day. Happy 30th birthday, my love.

Your wife

Special birthday edition

Exclusive: a prayer from your wife

Joshua, this is my prayer for you in this season. I pray that God shows you mercy, mercy upon mercy. You are blessed far beyond what you can even comprehend. May God’s grace speak for you in every room. This season comes with open doors, doors of opportunity and breakthrough, and many favors, favor with God and favor with people.

I am trusting God for 30 miracles for you between now and December. Tap each number when your miracle comes.
